limitations: Synthetic intercepted API and GIS contracts; no actual backend, Google, email, database or production-origin validation.
400% reflow represented by a 320 CSS-pixel viewport; 200% text doubles computed text sizes.
Small viewport models keyboard-constrained space; it is not an actual mobile OS keyboard test.
Navigation timings are local observations, not production performance guarantees; initial delivery byte limits are deterministic.
Keyboard and semantic assertions are not a complete screen-reader or contrast audit.
Screenshots require human/agent visual review; saving them alone is not visual approval.
